class.name: LandscapeData
class.brief_description: Heightmap and material layer weights of a [Landscape3D].
class.description: Stores the terrain as a regular grid of heights (in meters, 32-bit float) and up to 16 weight-blended material layers stored as four RGBA8 weightmaps (one channel per layer, the weights of a texel sum to 1). The texel [code](x, z)[/code] is located at [code](x * vertex_spacing, height, z * vertex_spacing)[/code] in the local space of the [Landscape3D], so the landscape covers [code](size - 1) * vertex_spacing[/code] meters along each axis (see [member size]). The resolution is limited to 16384 texels per side, e.g. 16 x 16 km with a vertex spacing of 1 m. When modifying the data directly, call [method notify_region_changed] so that the landscapes using it update their GPU data, LOD tree and collision. [b]Splines:[/b] [LandscapeSpline3D] nodes (roads, rivers, streams, lakes) modify the terrain non-destructively. The tiles under splines keep a base layer, the terrain as sculpted and painted, and their final heights and weights are composited from the base and the splines. The editing tools ([LandscapeBrush], [method set_heightmap_image], [method fill_layer], [method set_layer_weights_image]...) edit this base layer, which is the final data everywhere else: in the editor, the splines stay on top of the sculpted terrain. At runtime, brush edits are written through the base and the final data. The getters such as [method get_height] return the final data, [method get_edit_height] the base layer.

method.name: clear_base_layer
method.description: Drops the base layer kept under splines, keeping the final data: the current spline deformations become part of the sculpted terrain. The splines are applied again on top of it when they change or when [method Landscape3D.rebuild_splines] is called.

method.name: clear_holes
method.description: Removes all holes.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a flat landscape of [param size] texels with the given vertex spacing and height. All texels are assigned to the first layer.

method.name: ensure_layer_capacity
method.description: Allocates enough weightmaps to paint [param layer_count] layers.

method.name: export_heightmap
method.description: Exports the heightmap. [code].exr[/code] keeps the heights in meters (32-bit float), [code].png[/code] (16-bit) and [code].r16[/code]/[code].raw[/code] (16-bit little-endian) are normalized to [method get_height_range].

method.name: fill_layer
method.description: Assigns the whole landscape to [param layer].

method.name: get_dominant_layer
method.description: Returns the layer with the highest weight at the given texel.

method.name: get_edit_height
method.description: Returns the height of a texel in the edit layer: the terrain without the splines under splines (see [LandscapeSpline3D]), the final height elsewhere.

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the height of a texel (coordinates are clamped).

method.name: get_height_range
method.description: Returns the minimum and maximum heights as [code]Vector2(min, max)[/code].

method.name: get_heightmap_image
method.description: Returns the heightmap as an [constant Image.FORMAT_RF] image.

method.name: get_layer_weight
method.description: Returns the weight ([code]0..1[/code]) of [param layer] at the given texel.

method.name: get_loaded_tile_count
method.description: Returns the number of storage tiles currently loaded in memory.

method.name: get_memory_usage
method.description: Returns the memory used by the loaded tiles, in bytes. It is kept below [member ProjectSettings.rendering/landscape/streaming/cpu_cache_size_mb] by evicting the least recently used tiles.

method.name: get_region
method.description: Returns a copy of the heights and/or weights of a region, as a dictionary with the keys [code skip-lint]rect[/code], [code skip-lint]heights[/code] ([PackedFloat32Array]) and [code skip-lint]weightmaps[/code] (array of [PackedByteArray]). Under splines, the edit layer is also stored ([code skip-lint]base_heights[/code] and [code skip-lint]base_weightmaps[/code]). The result can be restored with [method set_region], e.g. for undo.

method.name: get_spline_records
method.description: Returns what the splines applied to this data: spline id → hash and texel rect of each block of the spline (see [LandscapeSpline3D]). Used by [Landscape3D] to only apply again the parts of the splines that changed, also when the scene was edited while the data wasn't loaded.

method.name: get_weightmap_count
method.description: Returns the number of allocated weightmaps (4 layers per weightmap).

method.name: get_weightmap_image
method.description: Returns the weightmap [param index] as an [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBA8] image. Channel [code]c[/code] of weightmap [code]i[/code] holds the weights of layer [code]i * 4 + c[/code].

method.name: get_world_size
method.description: Returns the size of the landscape in meters.

method.name: has_base_layer
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if tiles keep a base layer, i.e. splines modify the terrain.

method.name: has_holes
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the hole mask is allocated (holes were painted at least once).

method.name: has_unsaved_changes
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the data was modified since it was loaded or saved.

method.name: import_heightmap
method.description: Imports a heightmap: 16-bit PNG, RAW/R16 (square, 16-bit little-endian), EXR or any image supported by [Image]. Normalized values are mapped to [code]value * scale + offset[/code]. If [param resize] is [code]true[/code], the landscape takes the resolution of the image, otherwise the image is resampled.

method.name: import_layer_weights
method.description: Imports a grayscale mask (16-bit PNG, RAW/R16, EXR or any image supported by [Image]) as the weights of [param layer]. The other layers share the remaining weight.

method.name: is_hole
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given texel is a hole.

method.name: is_streamed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the data is backed by a [code].lsdata[/code] file: the tiles are then loaded on demand.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the data has been created.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Loads a [code].lsdata[/code] file. Only the header is read, the tiles are streamed when they are needed. Loading the file with [method @GDScript.load] or [ResourceLoader] does the same.

method.name: notify_region_changed
method.description: Notifies the landscapes that the given texel region changed. [param flags] is a combination of [enum ChangeFlags]. Emits [signal region_changed].

method.name: remove_layer
method.description: Removes the weights of [param layer] and shifts the following layers down by one.

method.name: resize
method.description: Resamples heights and weights to a new resolution, keeping the world size.

method.name: sample_height
method.description: Returns the height at a position in local space, with bilinear interpolation.

method.name: sample_normal
method.description: Returns the normal at a position in local space.

method.name: save_to_file
method.description: Saves the data to a [code].lsdata[/code] file (tiles of every mip level, compressed, plus the LOD tree), which then backs the data. Saving the resource with [ResourceSaver] to a [code].lsdata[/code] path does the same. The file being streamed can be overwritten.

method.name: set_height
method.description: Sets the height of a texel. Call [method notify_region_changed] after modifying heights.

method.name: set_heightmap_image
method.description: Replaces the heights with an image (resampled to the current resolution). Values are mapped to [code]value * scale + offset[/code].

method.name: set_hole
method.description: Makes a texel a hole or solid again. Holes are not rendered and have no collision. The hole mask is allocated on first use. Call [method notify_region_changed] with [constant CHANGED_HOLES] after modifying holes.

method.name: set_layer_weight
method.description: Sets the weight of [param layer] at a texel. The other layers are rescaled so that the weights still sum to 1. Call [method notify_region_changed] after modifying weights.

method.name: set_layer_weights_image
method.description: Uses an image (resampled to the current resolution) as the weights of [param layer]. The other layers share the remaining weight.

method.name: set_region
method.description: Restores a region returned by [method get_region] and notifies the change.

method.name: set_spline_records
method.description: Sets what the splines applied to this data, see [method get_spline_records].

method.name: set_weightmap_count
method.description: Sets the number of allocated weightmaps (0 to 4).

method.name: set_weightmap_image
method.description: Replaces the weightmap [param index] with an image (resampled to the current resolution).

method.name: trim_memory
method.description: Evicts tiles until the memory usage is within the budget. This happens automatically after edits and every frame for landscapes being rendered.

members.member: The base layer of the tiles under splines, for embedded resources ([code].lsdata[/code] files store it in their tiles): storage tile coordinates → base heights and weightmaps of the tile.
The heights of all texels, row by row.
The hole mask, one byte per texel ([code]0[/code]: solid). Empty when the landscape has no holes.
What the splines applied to this data, see [method get_spline_records].
The resolution of the landscape in texels. Use [method create] or [method resize] to change it.
The distance in meters between two heightmap texels.
The weightmaps (RGBA8, one channel per layer).

signal.name: region_changed
signal.description: Emitted by [method notify_region_changed] when the texels in [param rect] were modified. [param flags] is a combination of [enum ChangeFlags]. [Landscape3D] only updates the modified parts of the GPU maps, LOD tree and collision.
